# Build Guide: 'Katniss Everdeen' 2.0 Archers & Melee (Skyline Valley)

![Build Guide: 'Katniss Everdeen' 2.0 Archers & Melee (Skyline Valley)](/uploads/203_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

After the first "Katniss Everdeen" archer build from 2020, I have now expanded the possibilities of the build in 2024 and fixed a problem in the build by combining it with melee combat. Bows are not very common in Appalachia. Many players don't even know the potential and have probably never tested a bow. This build now shows how you can get along well in the wasteland as an **archer / melee build**.

One problem with the bow is the slow rate of fire. Similar to rifle shooting, you have difficulties with this if you are standing directly in front of several opponents and may also be spotted. This is where close combat comes into play. As soon as the bow is too close to the opponent, you can switch to close combat.

This build is ideal for playing both bows and melee in stealth mode, as the bow is also very quiet and contains the keyword "hasSilencer". All sneak attack bonuses are included and optimize damage.

![Archer & Melee Build](/uploads/nukaknights-build-bowsmelee-skywalka55-fallout76-20240630-21-43-15-gallery.jpg)

The only compromise you have to accept when it comes to melee combat with this build is the **mutations**. Since most enemies are fought with the bow, the focus is on **herbivores** and melee damage cannot be maximized with meat food buffs. However, you can still use strength buffs and chems. A pure carnivore melee fighter is definitely stronger than melee this build.

This **Archer build** plays **Bloodstained** as this is where the most damage, stealth and melee bonuses are possible. Full life may be possible, but not with comparable efficiency.

## Important: How to play with the bow

Dealing with **VATS**: 

1. Draw the bow (keep the trigger pressed)
2. Enable VATS
3. Release shot (release trigger)

After the VATS is active, you can continue shooting. If you first activate the VATS and then draw the bow, this can lead to missed hits. But I was able to adjust to it quickly.

**Range:** Bows have a theoretical range of 300 but this is hardly usable in practice as the arrows fall very quickly and land on the bow. This makes it very difficult to hit with a bow at a distance. **It's not a problem in VATS**, where the trajectory is automatically calculated and you hit very well.

The **rate of fire** appears slower in first person than in third person. Try it yourself, for me the **third-person perspective is the optimal choice for the bow**. This allows you to shoot quickly one after the other.

*Tip:* When enemies are nearby, or in events, always **draw the bow again after shooting**. Then you can immediately activate VATS again and fire as soon as an enemy appears.

## Equipment

The build does not use the normal bow, but the **Compound Bow**. The compound bow is significantly stronger than the normal one and is **tradable**. However, the plan cannot be traded and can only be obtained in exchange for bottle caps with maximum reputation with the settlers or raiders. You can also buy a legendary compound bow from other players without the plan.

In contrast to other weapons, **explosion arrows** for bows and crossbows can be used via mountable **mods** (plans also available for settlers/raiders) regardless of the weapon's legendary effects. I have also tested the **Fire**, **Plasma**, and **Cold** arrows and prefer playing with the Explosive and **Ultracite** arrows. By the plasma arrows
